name: Artisan: Going Home Again
source: To save her childhood home Ellie must pursue an unlikely career in the only thing she's actually good at: Art. Can she succeed on her own, or learn to lean on the strength of her new friends? And will any amount of success give her what she's actually looking for?
translation: 为了拯救童年的家园，艾莉必须从事她唯一真正擅长的事情——艺术，这是一个不太可能的职业。她能靠自己取得成功，还是学会依靠新朋友的力量？任何程度的成功都会给她带来她真正想要的东西吗？
